title: dianthus cretaceus subsp. multicaulis
intro: Dianthus cretaceus subsp. multicaulis, commonly known as the Carnation or Garden Pink, is a perennial plant species in the family Caryophyllaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, helping to soothe and protect the skin from various irritations and infections. The therapeutic actions of Dianthus cretaceus subsp. multicaulis include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit sedative and spasmolytic properties, making it a valuable addition to traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and are responsible for its medicinal effects.
